purpose: Align AC1021 DWG POLYLINE_3D writer admission with the documented fields and prevent loss of unrepresentable DXF group-70 values.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: The first RC represents spline curve type 5 or 6 and implies DXF group-70 bit 4; the second RC carries only the closed bit. Object type 16 supplies the 3D bit.

implementation.behavior: Reject conflicting 3D/mesh/polyface topology, closed-N without mesh topology, unsupported 3D group-70 bits, non-DWG 3D curve type 8, and disagreement between spline-fit bit 4 and curve type 5/6. Preserve supported closed and spline-fit mappings. Refusals occur before the staged DWG body is published.

refusedProfiles.reason: curve-fit flag has no 3D DWG field
continuous-linetype flag has no 3D DWG field

generatedControls.failureRetry: Each refusal preserves the writer buffer; a corrected flags-9 profile succeeds on the same writer.

validation.fixturePolicy: All controls are generated in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: This is writer/parser field-domain and transaction evidence for the AC1021 3D POLYLINE body, not native curve rendering or producer prevalence.
The selected FreeCAD closed-3D-polyline importer gap remains separate; this change preserves the correct DXF/DWG flags and does not alter consumer output.
supportClaimEffect: Closes a bounded silent-loss risk for the documented AC1021 3D POLYLINE flags; no broad DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
